architecture.cross_attention: Decoder state supplies queries; encoder output supplies keys and values.
architecture.decoder: Six post-norm decoder blocks: masked self-attention, encoder-decoder attention, feed-forward, each with residual then layernorm.
architecture.encoder: Six post-norm encoder blocks: multi-head self-attention, residual/add+layernorm, feed-forward, residual/add+layernorm.
essential_constraints: No future-token access in decoder self-attention.
The 2017 original is post-norm; do not substitute modern pre-norm silently.
Masking is not applied to all encoder self-attention.
architecture.output: Linear projection and softmax predict next token using right-shifted target input.

architecture.loss: MSE only on masked patches against original pixels.
architecture.pretraining: Split image into patches; randomly remove 75%; embed visible patches with positions; heavy ViT encoder sees only visible tokens; insert mask tokens and positions in lightweight decoder; reconstruct pixel patches.
